concepts.plainMeaning: the yearly cost of a loan, including fees, written as a percentage
concepts.roleHere: how lenders quote the price of a loan

bad.text: Every loan offer shows an APR in large print. Lenders compete on it, so the smaller the APR, the cheaper the loan usually is for you.
Now compare two offers side by side and pick the one that costs less over a full year.

good.text: Every loan offer shows an APR, which stands for annual percentage rate. It means the yearly cost of a loan, including fees, written as a percentage.
Lenders compete on the APR, so a smaller APR usually means a cheaper loan for you.
